source_type_legend.domain: Checkable claims documented in real domain systems and engineering literature.
source_type_legend.formal: Predicate definitions grounded in formal semantics, property patterns, or standards.
source_type_legend.technical: Technical sources that define backend, algorithm, and execution-receipt boundaries.

evidence_levels.W2: Established within the predicate soundness fragment by a terminating, executable, source-attributed receipt.
evidence_levels.W1: A precisely located semantic candidate without a sound registered predicate or backend; retained as a semantic finding.
evidence_levels.W0: An unresolved or imprecisely located candidate retained as a coverage gap, not as an established finding.

predicates.name: element_exists
predicates.semantics: A named element of the specified kind belongs to the closed declaration inventory.

predicates.name: transition_exists
predicates.semantics: A transition exists between the specified source and target.

predicates.name: trigger_set_equals
predicates.semantics: The parsed trigger set of a transition equals the required trigger set.

predicates.name: state_action_attached
predicates.semantics: The specified action is attached to the specified lifecycle phase of the specified state.

predicates.name: transition_guard_equals
predicates.semantics: The parsed guard of a transition equals the required guard.

predicates.name: transition_effect_attached
predicates.semantics: The specified effect belongs to the effect set of the specified transition.

predicates.name: may_reach
predicates.semantics: A finite graph path exists from the source set to the target set.

predicates.name: must_reach
predicates.semantics: Under the declared graph completion, every path from the source eventually visits the target.

predicates.name: route_avoids
predicates.semantics: Every path from the source to the target avoids the forbidden node or edge set.

predicates.name: coaccessible_to
predicates.semantics: Every root-reachable node can reach a marked node along a finite path.

predicates.name: event_consumed
predicates.semantics: The exact event occurs and is consumed in the declared macrostep.

predicates.name: state_reached_after
predicates.semantics: The target state is active in the trailing portion of the declared trace window.

predicates.name: behavior_occurs
predicates.semantics: The specified behavior occurs at the specified owner and slot within the trace.

predicates.name: state_retained
predicates.semantics: The target state remains active at every recorded point in the closed interval.

families.label: Bounded verification
families.evidence_form: A closed state-space, guard, or bounded-response check.

predicates.name: guards_disjoint
predicates.semantics: No two guards in the same choice group are simultaneously satisfiable within the declared domain.

predicates.name: guards_complete
predicates.semantics: The disjunction of guards in the same choice group covers the declared input domain.

predicates.name: response_within
predicates.semantics: After every supported occurrence of p, q occurs within the declared bound and unit.

predicates.name: deadlock_free
predicates.semantics: Every reachable, stable, nonterminal configuration admits model progress.

predicates.name: state_invariant
predicates.semantics: Every reachable configuration satisfies the expected occupancy value of the specified state.
